name: Galapagos Albatrosses
study_objective: Track foraging trips of waved albatrosses breeding on Espanola Island in the Galapagos.
citation: Cruz S, Proano CB, Anderson D, Huyvaert K, Wikelski M (2013). Data from: The Environmental-Data Automated Track Annotation (Env-DATA) System supports geospatial analyses of albatross tracks. Movement Ecology 1:3.
acknowledgements: Funded by the National Geographic Society and the Max Planck Institute for Animal Behavior.

name: Turkey Vulture Acopian Center USA GPS
study_objective: Long-term satellite tracking of turkey vultures across North and South America to study migration and range use.
citation: Bildstein KL, Barber DR, Bechard MJ (2020). Data from: Turkey vulture (Cathartes aura) migration in the Americas. Movebank Data Repository.
acknowledgements: Hawk Mountain Sanctuary and the Acopian Center for Conservation Learning.

name: MPIAB white stork lifetime tracking
study_objective: Track white storks from the nest across their first migrations to unravel decision-making during group migration.
citation: Flack A, Nagy M, Fiedler W, Couzin ID, Wikelski M (2018). From local collective behavior to global migratory patterns in white storks. Science 360:911-914.
acknowledgements: Max Planck Institute for Animal Behavior.

name: African Elephant Movements Kruger
study_objective: Long-term GPS tracking of African elephants in Kruger National Park to inform corridor and conflict management.
citation: Slotow R (2016). GPS telemetry of African elephants in Kruger National Park. Movebank Data Repository.

name: Serengeti Lion Project GPS
study_objective: Track pride movements of Serengeti lions to study territoriality and conflict.
citation: Packer C (2016). Movement of Serengeti lions. Movebank Data Repository.

name: Yellowstone Wolves
study_objective: Long-term GPS/VHF monitoring of Yellowstone gray wolves for population and behavior research.
citation: Smith DW, MacNulty DR, Stahler DR (2020). Yellowstone wolf project GPS telemetry. Yellowstone Center for Resources.

name: Adelie Penguins on the move
study_objective: Foraging trips of Adelie penguins at Dumont d'Urville, Antarctica.
citation: Ropert-Coudert Y (2015). Adelie penguins tracking. Movebank Data Repository.

name: Blackpoll Warbler autumn migration
study_objective: Track transoceanic autumn migration of Blackpoll warblers from northeastern North America to South America.
citation: DeLuca WV, Woodworth BK, Rimmer CC (2015). Transoceanic migration by a 12-g songbird. Biology Letters 11:20141045.

name: White Shark GPS Guadalupe
taxon_ids: Carcharodon carcharias (great white shark, marine fish)
study_objective: Satellite tracking of great white sharks in the eastern Pacific.
citation: Domeier ML (2013). Global perspectives on the biology and life history of the white shark. CRC Press.

name: European Roller migration ICARUS
study_objective: Full-annual-cycle tracking of European rollers linking European breeding to sub-Saharan African wintering.
citation: Safi K, Wikelski M (2022). European Roller migration tracking. Movebank Data Repository.

name: Loggerhead Sea Turtle Mediterranean
taxon_ids: Caretta caretta (loggerhead sea turtle, marine reptile)
study_objective: Long-term satellite tracking of loggerhead sea turtles in the Mediterranean.
citation: Casale P (2021). Loggerhead sea turtles in the Mediterranean. Movebank Data Repository.
acknowledgements: University of Pisa and WWF Italy.

name: Caribou Migration Yukon
study_objective: Track caribou herds in the Yukon and Alaska to inform migratory corridor protection.
citation: Joly K, Gunn A, Cote SD (2019). Longest terrestrial migrations and movements around the world. Scientific Reports 9:15333.
acknowledgements: US National Park Service and Government of Yukon.
